mapper.select: SELECT a.assignment_id AS assignmentId, p.project_id AS projectId, p.project_no AS projectNo, p.project_name AS projectName, c.client_name AS clientName, c.client_id AS clientId, a.contract_start_date AS contractStartDate, a.contract_end_date AS contractEndDate, a.assignment_status AS assignmentStatus, assignment_code.code_name AS assignmentStatusName, a.role_name AS roleName, a.processes AS processes, a.remarks AS remarks FROM assignments a INNER JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = a.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = p.client_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN common_codes assignment_code ON assignment_code.code_type = 'ASSIGNMENT_STATUS' AND assignment_code.code_value = a.assignment_status AND assignment_code.is_active = TRUE WHERE a.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.contract_start_date DESC, a.assignment_id DESC
